notes.title: Kickstarter Launch Announcement
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that our Kickstarter campaign for The Cartesian Project will be going live on November 8th, 2021! We’ve been working on this game for several years and we’re hopeful that this Kickstarter campaign will give us the funding we need to finally bring the game to market. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lastshotstudios/the-cartesian-project]Check it out here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/52bb6bfa2c78b5570d96ef3ac349956dde3b8805.png[/img]

We've also released our promo trailer earlier this week, check it out below!

[previewyoutube=ZeAmXT-U0J8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Kickstarter will be live for 30 days: November 8th to December 7th. We’ve provided a ton of details about the lore and mechanics of the game, and have included concept art and in-game footage! We have a wide variety of tiers, from $2 up to $2500, so give them a read to see what might interest you! 

We sincerely appreciate everyone supporting our Kickstarter as well as those watching from the sidelines, and thank you to all who have helped us get this far already!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that The Cartesian Project officially has functional multiplayer through Steam!

Our initial PvP workaround involved everyone on the team generating the same level in their game, jumping on a Discord group chat, and racing to see who could get to the end first. Though we had a lot of fun, it required each of us to have at least two monitors to watch and play while still feeling like a single-player experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/1b3d883233d77f644fc07984fd34bf30896ff121.jpg[/img]

In our latest update, we’re now able to create lobbies through Steam where everyone joins a lobby, entering the same level automatically when the host starts the game. Though the current experience has a long way to go, the game represents each player as a floating head with a colored aura.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/7475f26eb33e96298e2fae63370b433298775b3e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/de0d9acd982b884d0d00e98d8a8f34fe2cf2edde.jpg[/img]

With the Kickstarter starting soon, we will have more to show off in the coming months. We still need to work on specific aspects of the multiplayer experience before a full video will be available. You can help shape our multiplayer experience by supporting the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lastshotstudios/the-cartesian-project]Kickstarter[/url] and joining us on [url=https://discord.gg/kepptNkumF]Discord[/url].

See you there!

notes.title: LSS Featured on the KoloCast Podcast
notes.notes:
Our co-founder Joseph "CloudScorpion" Hughes was a special guest on the KoloCast podcast hosted by Mr.Aquaman. The KoloCast is a Fighting Game Podcast created by The Kolosseum Studios. During the podcast, CloudScorpion discusses his introduction to the competitive fighting game scene, opinions on the development of Mortal Kombat, and some new details about The Cartesian Project.

notes.title: Kickstarter Announcement
notes.notes:
Last Shot Studios is a small team with limited resources so it is crucial we explore all opportunities available to ensure we make this game the best that it can be. We are starting a Kickstarter campaign in the near future to help grow the team and support the realization of our vision for this game. With your help, we can achieve this together as a community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/7cec5c72179bf811567651c9e336ae3424bf1ec7.png[/img]
Kickstarter allows us to incorporate suggestions from game testers and community members early on in the game’s development cycle. Funding the Kickstarter would allow us to instantly grow the team, and could lead this project beyond our expectations. Through Kickstarter, we can gauge people’s interest in the game and receive the necessary feedback we need to bring The Cartesian Project to the next level.

Our Kickstarter campaign goal is $75,000 CAD. This will cover the costs of music production, creation of sound effects, more art, marketing, and everything else needed to bring this game to your PC. With the single-player campaign in its early stages, we are hoping to add multiple endings as our first stretch goal, with a boundless supply of ideas to make The Cartesian Project universe bigger than ever. You can support the campaign for the cost of a cup of coffee and have your name immortalized in the end game credits, or jump up to the royal tier and help design the final boss, with many options in between.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/0de61bf7a867666b1822e31c295af18cecccdd3d.png[/img]
As the development timeline stands right now, the Kickstarter will complete before the end of 2021. If successful, closed beta testing will be available by early Summer of 2022, with an open beta later that season. This will all lead up to a November 2022 release date.

In the meantime, we are partnering with The Kolosseum Rewind, a fighting game event hosted by NRS caster MrAquaman. We believe in supporting other grassroots organizations, so be sure to check them out on September 19th at 6 PM EST. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mraquaman]www.twitch.tv/mraquaman[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/beac19a1bbadb33cb1c5302504b8579b96154851.png[/img]
Be sure to follow the Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lastshotstudios/the-cartesian-project]here[/url], or get a sneak peek at the Kickstarter page before it goes live by clicking [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lastshotstudios/the-cartesian-project?ref=6obuyy&token=8cfae7ef]here[/url].

notes.title: Welcome to the Cartesian Project
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/10ca3ebf1dd7e0bb5ab24bde03ed6c25e4419f33.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to the Last Shot Studios Blog![/b]

Last Shot Studios is a small indie game development studio based in Toronto, Canada. We have been working on The Cartesian Project for over 5 years now. The Cartesian Project is a first-person platformer set in a procedurally generated world. We’ve developed our own game engine to create this world of endless possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/d104eeaef5e27742b68c02dbd9e2b5257c2be555.png[/img]

We’ve had to take on multiple roles to get the game to where it is now. We were pleasantly surprised by the overwhelmingly positive feedback we received when we demoed a pre-alpha build of the game at EGLX 2019. We will be sharing more content and information about the game and its development in the coming months, including screenshots, videos, and a gameplay demo.

We are aiming to use this blog for delivering content updates, development progress, as well as describing the obstacles and challenges intrinsic to indie game development; challenges such as cost management, arranging public exhibitions, determining the themes of the game, as well as other issues that we’ve experienced along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38905044/8a198994cc419fcddf030119f6a1b7445a427c50.png[/img]

We’d like to give you the opportunity to participate in the game’s development process. We will be launching a Kickstarter before the end of the year to support the development of the game so be sure to follow us there. You can engage with the development team through the game’s [url=https://discord.gg/f9yZSuw5Zu]Discord [/url], follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/LastShotStudios]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/LastShotStudios]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1423400/The_Cartesian_Project/]wishlist the game on Steam[/url].

As the world opens up again, we will be showing off the game at North American gaming conventions. So be sure to keep your eye out for more about The Cartesian Project.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1423400/The_Cartesian_Project/
